notes.title: Nominate Urchins & Ink for Most Innovative Gameplay
notes.content: In the same way, people learned Japanese phrases and character names through repetition and fun content in anime and games, Urchins & Ink aims to do the same with Japanese letters. Sumi the squid helps you learn a language without flashcards or standardized testing. Learn symbols at your own rate through fun gameplay and cute sea urchins. Nominate Urchins & Ink for Most Innovative Gameplay and change how you approach learning a language!
